intro: Greta Mosshoof is a tauren druid allied with the Emerald Circle at the Emerald Sanctuary in southern Felwood. Alongside night elves and fellow guardians of nature, she investigates the foul taint creeping across the ancient forest and directs scouts into the Shadow Council stronghold of Jaedenar.

p: Stationed at the Emerald Sanctuary on the southern boundary of Felwood, Greta Mosshoof works alongside the Emerald Circle to combat the pervasive corruption consuming the ancient woods. Rather than surrendering the blighted lands to the demonic taint left in the wake of the Third War, she coordinates efforts to understand and push back the spreading rot. Her investigations zero in on the poisoned waters of Felwood and the foul cultists burrowed within Jaedenar.
